dict.string: Peripheral Glow Track 9 fallback: If not using Studio Strings, use this Retro Synth patch. Sawtooth +5ct detune, very slow attack (0.8s bow). Use with Ensemble (0.8Hz, 3ms, 40% depth, 30% mix) and ChromaVerb (3.0s, 40% wet, Hall). Prefer Logic's Studio Strings if available.
Range: D5-F6 (high, ethereal). Enters Chorus 1 (bar 25). Expression CC11 bell-curve swells over 2-bar phrases (50-120). Velocity: 42 (Ch1), 50 (Ch2), 45-70 (Instrumental).
